contexts.text: Then all truth becomes like skin which cleaves to the bone; it is dried up, and becomes like wood ().
Under Dry, see these references. AE 131:4.
The river shall be dried up, and shall dry up () = that there shall be no doctrine of truth, and consequently no intelligence. AE 654:49.
Because they had no root, they withered away ()... To be burnt up and wither away = to be adulterated, and to perish.
We read in Jonah that the gourd withered away.
When the harvest withers () = the truths of good destroyed through evil loves.
To mourn, and to wither () = to perish, and to be dissipated through cupidities.
His spring shall dry up, and his fountain shall be dried up () = that from this ardour and this pride everything of doctrine and everything of the Word is destroyed. AE 483:15.
